descriptions.zh-Hans: 在苏州吃过汤面后画的菜单，旁边单画了一小格浇头。碗画得太圆，差点滚到纸边。
descriptions.en: A drawn menu from a bowl of soup noodles in Suzhou, with a separate little square for the topping. The bowl is so round it nearly rolls off the page.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过松鼠鳜鱼留下的手绘菜单。我把那道鱼画了两遍，第二遍总算没添上松鼠耳朵。
descriptions.en: A menu drawn after squirrel-shaped mandarin fish. It took two attempts to leave out the imaginary squirrel ears.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在与谁同坐轩旁描的扇形轮廓，没有照着大小画。纸角还留着找角度时的小箭头。
descriptions.en: My small sketch of the fan-shaped pavilion, with an arrow in the corner from the search for a good angle. Very much not to scale.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃完苏式汤面，我想一笔画完一碗面。笔尖绕了很久，最后在纸边打了一个小结。
descriptions.en: After my Suzhou noodles, I tried drawing a whole bowl without lifting the pencil. The line eventually tied itself into a knot at the edge.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在苏州博物馆，我和另一位游客互相指路，最后把小桥和两个找路的自己都画在了余纸上。他把画送我留着。
descriptions.en: At Suzhou Museum, another visitor and I tried giving each other directions. Our spare-paper sketch ended up with a bridge and two lost-looking travelers; they gave it to me.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我和一位旅人在同一张折纸两面画下与谁同坐轩，各给对方添了一个小小的邮包。这是我们临时合作的速写，不是园里的印刷品。
descriptions.en: A traveler and I drew the pavilion on opposite sides of one folded sheet, then each added a tiny mailbag to the other drawing. Our own improvised sketch, rather than a garden print.
